svg.title: A 32-bit add, four bits per clock
svg.desc: One add through the single 4-bit adder: eight clocks, least significant nibble first, the carry held in a flip-flop between them. Recorded from an RTL simulation, not computed in the browser. Made by docs/tools/motion.py from docs/site/data/traces/nibble-add.json.
svg.text: A 32-bit add, four bits per clock

text.tspan: One add through the single 4-bit adder: eight clocks, least significant nibble first, the carry held in a flip-flop
between them.
add x11, x9, x10 has arrived. The core waits in ALIGN until the register file's phase counter comes round to 0: every
pass starts there.
Phase 0: nibble 0 of x9 is 8, of x10 9; with carry-in 0 the 4-bit adder gives 1, carry-out 1. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
Phase 1: nibble 1 of x9 is 7, of x10 a; with carry-in 1 the 4-bit adder gives 2, carry-out 1. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
Phase 2: nibble 2 of x9 is 6, of x10 b; with carry-in 1 the 4-bit adder gives 2, carry-out 1. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
Phase 3: nibble 3 of x9 is 5, of x10 c; with carry-in 1 the 4-bit adder gives 2, carry-out 1. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
Phase 4: nibble 4 of x9 is 4, of x10 d; with carry-in 1 the 4-bit adder gives 2, carry-out 1. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
Phase 5: nibble 5 of x9 is 3, of x10 e; with carry-in 1 the 4-bit adder gives 2, carry-out 1. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
Phase 6: nibble 6 of x9 is 2, of x10 f; with carry-in 1 the 4-bit adder gives 2, carry-out 1. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
Phase 7: nibble 7 of x9 is 1, of x10 0; with carry-in 1 the 4-bit adder gives 2, carry-out 0. That nibble is written
into x11 as it leaves the bottom of the rotation.
